whatTheConclusionMeans: no retry of either same reserve is authorised

theHistoricalPauseRemainsTrue.firedOn: 2 of 5 planned items below the 4-raw-page surrogate, which is strictly more than 30% of the frozen five-item denominator
theHistoricalPauseRemainsTrue.whyItIsNotContradictedByThisResumption: P5 is a PAUSE, not a verdict. It stops a cadence so a person looks at it. The look has now happened; the pause stays on the record exactly as it fired

p5Review.reviewedAgainst: the Window 01 LIVE_RESULT and evidence adjudication, both committed and both re-hashed from disk in this step

theTwoLowYieldItems.concreteTransportFailure: CONNECT_TIMEOUT on both the first robots.txt request and its one bounded in-policy retry
TLS_FAILURE on the single robots.txt attempt

p5Review.whatTheyShare: a broad category only: a transport failure before a readable robots policy. A policy that was never read cannot authorise a page request, so both roots terminated with zero page attempts
p5Review.whatTheyDoNotShare: their concrete failure. CONNECT_TIMEOUT and TLS_FAILURE are different failures at different layers against different hosts
noEvidenceEstablishes: a common code repair that should precede further acquisition
positiveEvidenceAgainstARepositoryDefect: the other three items in the same window, under the same build, the same fetch policy and the same user agent, returned 13, 27 and 27 raw pages
both failing runs completed normally (cliExitCode 0, runTerminalState COMPLETED) and each wrote exactly one run and one completion row
no ORCHESTRATION_ERROR, no persistence anomaly and no host sleep/wake event occurred during the window
TLS verification was never weakened: rejectUnauthorized stayed true, so a TLS_FAILURE is the gateway refusing an unverifiable certificate, which is correct behaviour
p5Review.whatWasNotConcludedFromThat: that the two hosts are permanently or globally unreachable. A fetch result is a function of the vantage as much as of the site, and this review makes no claim about either institution

whatIsNotAuthorisedByThisResumption: retrying any completed or failed institution target
any change to robots evaluation or robots continuation
widening any connect, read or total timeout
any TLS relaxation, certificate exception or rejectUnauthorized change
any code, test, harness, methodology or migration change
raising the window or attempt caps
